dataset_description: The Urban Flow Prediction Survey provides a comprehensive overview of spatiotemporal data, preprocessing pipelines, and machine learning methods—ranging from statistical, traditional ML, deep learning, reinforcement learning, to transfer learning—for predicting urban crowd, traffic, and transit flows.
